llm.summary: The skill is mostly a local notes and Word-export tool, but it silently contacts ClawHub for update checks despite advertising no network use.

dimensions.detail: Using browser localStorage, IndexedDB, clipboard, file selection, drag-and-drop, and downloads is proportionate for this tool, but an automatic fetch to https://clawhub.ai/api/v1/skills/suji-board after page load is not clearly disclosed or necessary for core local note-taking.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a single HTML app with no dependency install script; the only packaging command is an optional skill-creator packaging instruction.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation text is broad for ordinary note-taking, clipping, clipboard organization, and packaging requests, which can cause over-selection, but the runtime instructions do not include prompt override or hidden agent-control behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The app persistently stores user notes, drafts, trash, folders, images, uploaded file blobs, and update-check cache in browser storage; this is mostly disclosed and user-directed, with no elevated OS privileges or long-running worker found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The note, image, folder, localStorage/IndexedDB, and DOCX export features fit the stated purpose, but the HTML performs an automatic remote version check even though the skill and product copy say it is local, offline, and does not upload or use the network.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this before installing if you need a truly offline/private note board. The app stores selected notes, images, and uploaded files locally, but it also makes an automatic ClawHub update-check request that is not disclosed in the offline/no-network claims. A safer version would make update checks manual or clearly opt-in.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Verified: SKILL.md and product-intro.md claim no networking/no upload, while assets/word-doc.html defines a ClawHub API URL and fetches it for version checks.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Verified: the remote request supports update discovery, not the core collection, image storage, folder, or DOCX export functions.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Verified: the description includes broad triggers such as generic text collection, quick notes, clipboard organization, and HTML-to-skill packaging; this is a routing-quality concern rather than evidence of malicious behavior.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Verified: the when-to-use section repeats broad activation conditions and lacks exclusions for generic note-taking or unrelated productivity tasks.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Verified: assets/word-doc.html schedules doCheck(false) three seconds after page load, causing a background network request unless a recent local cache suppresses it.
